Aqui se quedan apuntados, con su progres: They're tracked here, with their progress and the relic or direct source to farm each one right now.
Aqui se ven las guias de YouTube sin sal: YouTube guides play here without leaving Farmadex, in case you play on a single monitor. With "Video mode" the window keeps only the video, on top of the game, and "Exit video" takes you back to the normal view.
Atrae a los Legacytes y capturalos; si s: Lure the Legacytes and capture them; if the first one escapes, the mission fails.
Aviso: {n} nombres de las tablas de drop: Warning: {n} names from the drop tables are not in the catalog; one of the sources is behind the patch
Busca guias en YouTube de la mision o el: Searches YouTube for guides on the open mission or item, sorted by views, and opens them in the Farmadex player.
Busca por el nombre del objeto, la pieza: Search by the name of the item, part, mod or relic (e.g. Rhino, Serration, Axi A7), not by questions.
Busca un objeto, una mision o pregunta: Search an item, a mission or ask  (e.g. ash prime systems, hepit, latest warframe)
Cada 3 ordenes cumplidas dan un premio d: Every 3 orders completed give a reward from A; each order, one from B (depending on the chosen boss); and finishing the mission gives one from C.
Cada escondite encontrado da un premio:: Each cache found gives a reward: the first A, the second B and the third C. For C you need to find all three.
Cada etapa superada da un premio y suma: Each stage cleared gives a reward and adds progress; reaching certain tiers unlocks rewards you can only claim once a week. You can leave after any stage.
Cada tipo de mision tiene su objetivo (a: Each mission type has its own objective (hold out, defend, capture...) and its own way of giving rewards: a single one at the end, or one every so often while you keep going.
Cada warframe, arma o companero subido a: Each warframe, weapon or companion raised to rank 30 (40 for some) gives mastery points once. 'Not mastered' means it would still give them.
Calculado con ritmo de juego {ritmo} (x{: Calculated for a {ritmo} play pace (x{factor}); change it in Settings.
Cantidad leida en pantalla la ultima vez: Amount read on screen the last time you opened the Inventory or the Foundry with Farmadex watching. It may go stale until you open them again.
Captura y manten las cuatro torres (A, B: Capture and hold the four towers (A, B, C and D) to score points before the enemy does.
Cierra el video y borra la sesion y la c: Closes the video and clears the guide player's session and cache
Combate en la arena de Kela De Thaym (Ra: Fight in Kela De Thaym's arena (Rathuum): reach 25 kills before her executioners.
Con \"+ Objetivo\" (o \"+ Set completo\": With "+ Goal" (or "+ Full set" for a whole Prime) you add what you're looking at to your goals list, with a progress bar and the best route to get it right now.
Con Archwing, destruye los tres transpor: With Archwing, destroy the three Corpus transports before they escape.
Con Archwing, persigue una nave Grineer,: With Archwing, chase a Grineer ship, disable its engine and shield generators, and defend your ship.
Con Ctrl+M (o este boton) la ventana pas: With Ctrl+M (or this button) the window switches to a small box meant for playing or streaming, with just the search and the essentials. Click a result and its details unfold right below, and with "Pin" it stays on top of the game. You can move and resize the window by dragging from any edge.
Con Warframe en Ventana sin bordes (o ve: With Warframe in Borderless window (or a normal window), opening a relic makes Farmadex read its rewards on its own and draw them on screen. Here you turn that automatic reading on or off, and a bit further down you choose whether they're shown as small tags or as a panel, and what to highlight in big letters: what you're missing, platinum or ducats.
Con el perfil, la ficha de cada objeto e: With the profile, each item's card in Search shows whether you have already mastered it, and here you will see what you are missing by category and the nodes you have not completed. Farmadex does not ask Digital Extremes for anything: it only reads the file you give it.

Por que avisa Windows al instalarlo: Why Windows warns you when installing it
Windows ensena un aviso azul (\"Windows: Windows shows a blue warning ("Windows protected your PC") for new programs that do not carry a paid digital signature. Farmadex does not have one yet: it is free, made by a single person, and that signature costs a lot of money every year. The warning does not mean it has a virus, only that Windows does not know it yet. To continue, click "More info" and then "Run anyway".
Descargalo solo de la pagina de versione: Only download it from the project's releases page: {enlace}. If someone passes it to you some other way (a Discord, a download site, a friend), you cannot know whether someone changed it. All the code is right there, open to anyone who wants to review it.
Como comprobar que el fichero es el buen: How to check that the file is the right one
Junto a cada version hay un fichero {sum: Next to each version there is a {sumas} file with the fingerprint of each download. Open PowerShell in the folder where you downloaded it and type {orden}. If the long number it shows is exactly the same as the one in {sumas}, the file is the one that was published. If a single letter differs, do not open it.
El registro que escribe el propio juego: The log the game itself writes (EE.log), only to know when you open a relic or finish a mission. That file contains your email and your IP: Farmadex only looks in it for a few game messages and does not store or send anything from it.

No lee ni escribe la memoria del juego,: It does not read or write the game's memory, does not watch or change its connection, does not modify its files, does not press keys for you, does not log into your account and never asks for your password.

Con {atajo} se abre y se cierra encima d: {atajo} opens and closes it on top of the game, and Escape hides it. When you do not see it, it keeps waiting among the icons next to the Windows clock; right-click there to quit completely.
Es seguro para mi cuenta?: Is it safe for my account?
Farmadex no toca el juego: ni su memoria: Farmadex does not touch the game: not its memory, not its connection, not its files. It only looks at the screen and the log the game itself writes, like other tools the community has used for years. Even so, DE does not approve any third-party program, so nobody can guarantee you anything: read its stance in Settings > About and decide for yourself.

Arriba los separas en Sin empezar, En pr: At the top you split them into Not started, In progress and Completed, and you can filter by category (sets, resources, weapons...). For each one you set how many you want and add several at once; a set unfolds with a click to show its parts, and for a weapon you can track its crafting resources separately. Farmadex asks before deleting, and you can tick several to remove them together.
En \"Personalizar y avisos\" eliges que: In "Customise and notifications" you choose what Windows tells you about even while the window is hidden: when Baro arrives, when there is a fissure or invasion you care about, night on Cetus... There you can also hide the sections you don't use and filter by faction. And clicking a reward opens its page.
Abre en el juego la pantalla de mejoras: In the game, open the upgrade screen of a warframe or weapon and press {atajo}: Farmadex reads its mods and arcanes and lists them here. Click one and it tells you where it comes from.
Para saber si un mod agrietado es bueno:: To find out whether a riven mod is good: hover the card in the game and press {atajo}, or enter its stats by hand. You get a grade for each one, from S (best) to F, the range it can roll in, and a reference price on warframe.market.
En Apariencia haces la ventana y la letr: In Appearance you make the window and the text bigger or smaller and change any colour. You see it first in the preview, and it only applies when you press Save; "Back to factory settings" puts everything back as it was.
